title: Indexed industry unemployment
intent: Compare four U.S. industries as relative unemployment change from January 2008.

ai.create: Create a multi-series time chart from the industries dataset that indexes each industry to its January 2008 unemployment, draws a 100% reference rule, and directly labels each final value.
ai.maintain: Change the industry selection or index date while retaining the original date, industry, and unemployed fields through normalization, stable colors, inferred channels, and percentage labels.
